chunks: And reward them for their perseverance Paradise and silken robes,
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for patience in Islam according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Insan is often linked to the Ahl al-Bayt, particularly Imam Ali and the Imams, who exemplified ultimate patience during times of hardship and exile. The mention of 'Harir' (fine silk) signifies not only material luxury but also the high spiritual status and honor bestowed upon the steadfast believers, distinguishing their reward from mere worldly comfort.
